FR-001.title: Maintain one signal per sale expressing whether any change to it is outstanding

FR-002.title: Signal counts concurrent writes rather than holding a single yes/no

FR-003.title: Every sale-changing operation registers in the signal while outstanding

FR-004.title: A confirmed change still waiting out a coalescing window counts as outstanding or is sent first

FR-005.title: Unconfirmed typed text never counts as outstanding

FR-006.title: Signal clears when a write settles, success or failure — no permanent lockout

FR-007.title: Each step's primary action unavailable while the signal reports outstanding

FR-008.title: Unavailability is visible on the action, reusing its existing busy treatment

FR-009.title: Gate does not extend to the rest of the surface — lines stay editable

FR-010.title: Exactly one mechanism expresses write-outstanding; the unused flag is wired or removed

FR-011.title: Mechanism is adoptable outside POS and coexists with per-form submitting flags

FR-012.title: Registering a write does not change what it does or how refusals surface

FR-013.title: Discount field text is confirmed only by pressing Enter, both layouts

FR-014.title: Focus loss or teardown discards unconfirmed discount text and restores the line's value

FR-015.title: A discard is acknowledged with the quantity field's cross-fade and colour pulse

FR-016.title: Unreadable discount text is discarded with the acknowledgement and never sent

FR-017.title: A refused discount restores visibly instead of being rewritten silently

FR-018.title: Unconfirmed text loses when the line changes underneath

FR-019.title: A confirmed discount edit registers in the signal and keeps its current line behaviour

FR-020.title: The confirm-or-discard rule and its acknowledgement exist in one shared place

FR-021.title: Adopting the rule does not change the discount field's appearance or the band's layout

FR-022.title: Every editable POS sale field is either covered by the rule or recorded as excluded with a reason

FR-023.title: Fields holding no server value are left unchanged

FR-024.title: A step action pressed with unconfirmed text neither advances, discards nor commits silently — it asks

FR-025.title: The question offers exactly three outcomes: keep, discard, keep editing

FR-026.title: Keeping the value is indistinguishable from pressing Enter; the step advances only once it lands

FR-027.title: Discarding restores with the acknowledgement and then lets the step advance

FR-028.title: Returning to editing keeps the typed text and the current step

FR-029.title: The prompt appears only when unconfirmed text actually exists on the step

FR-030.title: Asked once for several unconfirmed fields; the answer applies to all of them

FR-031.title: Leaving a field by any other means still discards silently with the acknowledgement

context: issue: mictlanix/mbe-ui#164 — step continue actions pressable while a line write is in flight
area: lib/features/sales/presentation (capture, payment, delivery steps + pos_sale_controller, pos_step_controller, delivery_controller, payment_controller)
area: lib/features/sales/presentation/widgets/quantity_stepper.dart — spec 030's confirm-or-discard rule and reset animation to be generalized
constraint: spec 030 FR-004 — the quantity control stays live through its own writes; the new gate must not regress it
constraint: no mbe-api change, no codegen, no new dependency
audit: POS sale fields — discount in scope; price read-only, tax picker, payment amount (draft+explicit apply), destination editor form, reversal reason, product search, cash-session forms excluded
intent: No POS step may be left while a change to the sale is still outstanding, and no field may keep showing text the sale does not hold.
expectations: Converting existing per-form submitting flags (cash-session forms, inline customer form, destination editor) to the new mechanism
Adopting the mechanism on any screen outside point of sale
Making the line price writable or returning tax to a typed field
Giving the discount field a stepper, a debounce, or any commit path other than Enter
Locally computed totals while a write is outstanding
Queueing, retrying or persisting failed writes
Changing the conditions that already gate each step's action, or how refusals are surfaced
A global busy overlay over the register

decisions.decision: Step action pressed with unconfirmed text: warn and offer keep / discard / keep editing (FR-024…FR-031) — not a silent discard. Decided with requester 2026-08-23.
A confirmed-but-unsent change counts as outstanding for its whole ~400ms coalescing window plus its write; the window is never cut short (FR-004).
The gating mechanism lives in the shared core as a generic mechanism, POS as first adopter (FR-011).
